title: When the Garden Wakes
author: Ines Halloran
blurb: Edmund Galloway, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
